text: Program Description This program is the primary way of entering MBBS program of Capital Medical University; students will have a chance of learning basic subjects needed for clinical medicine course. Students will have enough time to get settled in China and understand the living and learning environment. Main Courses Medical terminology, biology, chemistry, Chinese language. For some students we might give English classes as well. Fee Structure For the students who join the Pre-Medical Program(Spring) Fee Description Total fee for Pre-med 25000 RMB Course duration: one semester Tuition & Dorm For the students who join in Pre-Medical/Clinical Medicine(Spring/Fall onetime payment) Fee Description Incidentals 18650 RMB Including: Admission fee Text books Registration fee Dorm fee Medical checkup Insurance Resident permit Lab coat Dorm deposit
